sourcePosition: Jenny Gu作者2018修订PDF第1页完整15题、第2页Scoring Information；2016上传稿题文一致但短版开发引文有更正

questions.authorEnglish: When I take a shower or a bath, I stay alert to the sensations of water on my body.
questions.platformChinese: 洗澡或泡澡时，我会留意水接触身体的感觉。

questions.authorEnglish: I’m good at finding words to describe my feelings.
questions.platformChinese: 我很会找到词语来描述自己的感受。

questions.authorEnglish: I don’t pay attention to what I’m doing because I’m daydreaming, worrying, or otherwise distracted.
questions.platformChinese: 因为在做白日梦、担心事情或被其他事分心，我没有注意自己正在做什么。

questions.authorEnglish: I believe some of my thoughts are abnormal or bad and I shouldn’t think that way.
questions.platformChinese: 我认为自己的一些想法不正常或不好，觉得不该那样想。

questions.authorEnglish: When I have distressing thoughts or images, I “step back” and am aware of the thought or image without getting taken over by it.
questions.platformChinese: 当出现令人苦恼的想法或画面时，我会“退后一步”，觉察它们，而不被它们带着走。

questions.authorEnglish: I notice how foods and drinks affect my thoughts, bodily sensations, and emotions.
questions.platformChinese: 我会注意食物和饮料怎样影响自己的想法、身体感觉和情绪。

questions.authorEnglish: I have trouble thinking of the right words to express how I feel about things.
questions.platformChinese: 我很难想到合适的词语，来表达自己对事情的感受。

questions.authorEnglish: I do jobs or tasks automatically without being aware of what I’m doing.
questions.platformChinese: 我会自动地做事或完成任务，却没有意识到自己正在做什么。

questions.authorEnglish: I think some of my emotions are bad or inappropriate and I shouldn’t feel them.
questions.platformChinese: 我认为自己的某些情绪不好或不合适，觉得不该有这些感受。

questions.authorEnglish: When I have distressing thoughts or images I am able just to notice them without reacting.
questions.platformChinese: 当出现令人苦恼的想法或画面时，我能够只是注意到它们，而不作出反应。

questions.authorEnglish: I pay attention to sensations, such as the wind in my hair or sun on my face.
questions.platformChinese: 我会留意一些感觉，比如风吹动头发，或阳光照在脸上的感觉。

questions.authorEnglish: Even when I’m feeling terribly upset I can find a way to put it into words.
questions.platformChinese: 即使心烦意乱，我也能找到用语言表达感受的方式。

questions.authorEnglish: I find myself doing things without paying attention.
questions.platformChinese: 我发现自己做事时没有留意。

questions.authorEnglish: I tell myself I shouldn’t be feeling the way I’m feeling.
questions.platformChinese: 我会告诉自己，不该有现在这样的感受。

questions.authorEnglish: When I have distressing thoughts or images I just notice them and let them go.
questions.platformChinese: 当出现令人苦恼的想法或画面时，我只是注意到它们，然后让它们过去。
